positive_snippets: The hotel maintained good hygiene, and the overall cleanliness was impressive. The staff was polite and supportive, and the service quality was good. However, the service time can be improved, as it was slightly delayed. Additionally, electrical appliances in the rooms should be checked regularly to ensure they are in proper working condition. Overall, a pleasant stay with scope for improvement.

I stayed at Hotel Olivia for almost four months, from September to January, during a business trip, and it was truly a pleasure staying here. The overall experience was very comfortable and pleasant throughout my stay.

I would especially like to mention Mr. Suresh, Mr. Anil, and Mr. Govind for their professionalism and courteous nature, which made the stay smooth and enjoyable.

I would definitely recommend Hotel Olivia for both short-term and long-term business stays.
Stayed here with my father for work-related travel and had a great experience. Affordable rates, good service, and nice food. Would definitely recommend.
negative_snippets:
I strongly advise anyone looking for a stay in Delhi to avoid this hotel. Do not be misled by the ratings; my experience was highly unprofessional from start to finish.

The Main Issues:

The Staff: Unwelcoming and frankly hostile. The receptionist (a bald man) was particularly rude and has no sense of hospitality or customer service.

Facilities: The geyser/hot water does not work. When you complain, they promise to send someone in 30 minutes, but you’ll be left waiting for 5–6 hours. They simply do not care about your comfort.

Food & Water: While the food itself tastes okay, the service is a nightmare. You have to order 2 hours in advance just to eat. Even getting basic bottled water (Bisleri) requires a long wait.

Final Verdict: This hotel is managed by people who are unprofessional and talk to guests very poorly. Save your money and your peace of mind—stay somewhere else.

The main issue was staff’s attitude. The receptionist was extremely unwelcoming and at times openly hostile. There was a clear lack of basic courtesy, hospitality, and customer service.
What stood out most was the complete absence of empathy. Instead of showing understanding of the situation, policies were used as a shield to justify rude behavior. It felt as though the rules were applied selectively rather than fairly and professionally. Overall, it was a very disappointing and unpleasant experience.
